effect.name: GM Organic
effect.desc: Grows a living cellular structure over the layer. A jittered cellular field gives the cells, the F2-F1 border between them becomes the vein network, and a band just inside each wall becomes the membrane. The source is then pulled outward from every cell centre so the tissue bulges, and the whole field can breathe. Six presets: tissue, a vein-dominant network, a membrane-dominant skin, pulsing cells, an irregular fungal growth and an elongated sinew. Cell size, size variation, field complexity, distortion, pulse rate, vein width, vein glow, membrane strength, an organic colour shift and the cell and vein colours are all separate. Layer space throughout.
